title: [finding] `activityMilestones[].type` is documented as defaulting to "completed", but a milestone without `type` writes `updated`
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:2123` (the `activityMilestones[].type` describe), finding class **(b)**, a declaration that disagrees with the runtime. `reach:` the exception for **release-fixed wrong text**. The describe is published in the generated reference `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx:357` and in the served JSON Schema of `ObjectSchema`. Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that owns `object.zod.ts` describes. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01ARcDurZ5j34RdqsGgc4jgH`, seat post #18917), from the at-tier contract review on PR #20485 (#19332 flight G2b), record `5876386886`, ③ boundary flags. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is false (read by this seat on `origin/main` `fc0db22b`)

- `object.zod.ts:2123`: `type: z.string().optional().describe('Activity type for the emitted row (default "completed").')`.
- The runtime default is not `completed`. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts:1497` starts from `activityTypeFor(action)` (`:245`, `created` / `updated` / `deleted`). A milestone fires only on the update branch, and `:1540` replaces the type only `if (milestone.type)`. So a milestone without `type` emits `updated`.
- It is already measured, not argued: `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-type-vocabulary-enforcement.test.ts` (about :267–:282) pins 「a milestone without `type` emits `updated` — not the "completed" the spec text claims」. Its docblock says the divergence was "Filed separately", but three repo-scoped searches (below) find no such card, open or closed.
- PR #20485's new form sub-row states the true default in its help text: 「left empty, the row keeps the ordinary update kind, updated」. The describe and the reference page are now the only surfaces that still say `completed`.

## Why it matters

An author, or an AI writing metadata, who reads the describe or the reference page leaves `type` unset expecting `completed` rows in the activity feed, and gets `updated`.

## Direction (for the claimant, ⛔ not a ruling)

Rewrite the describe to the real default (an unset `type` keeps the update row's kind, `updated`), and regenerate the reference page. Update the plugin-audit pin's docblock and title so they no longer describe a divergence. ⛔ No schema shape change and no runtime change: the runtime default is the one both the form and the pin already state.

## Dedupe

`mcp__github__search_issues`, repo-scoped, semantic, closed included, run 2026-09-28:
- 「activityMilestones type describe default completed runtime writes updated」 → 1 hit (#7290, closed, the summary-template lookup ids: a different defect);
- 「milestone activity type default completed object.zod describe」 → 0 hits;
- 「milestone without type emits updated not completed spec text claims」 → 2 hits (#19656, #10848: unrelated).

Dedupe words: `activityMilestones type default completed` · `milestone without type emits updated` · `activity type for the emitted row describe stale`

<sub>`domain:spec` seat 4 · #18917 · finding</sub>
